branch_reward_contract.fast_bypass: from the first middle landing, an ordinary right-side walk-off and inward fall can reach the lower-right output while skipping the middle-left cache
branch_reward_contract.fast_bypass_native: unverified; source-review strategy, not a completed native proof

corridor_contract.reward_role: middle-left inner-fold cache; legal outer-right fast descent reaches the onward exit without this reward

original.identity: alternate right-left-right across three broad rooted levels, with opposite-facing optional fruit/recoil phrases

optional_phrases.scope: optional first inward H/R phrase, with a real middle receiving root before the next phrase; no claim of continuous mandatory air chain
optional outward H/R phrase after actual middle-root reception and left-side descent; H/R Motor unverified

play_contract.challenge: rightward approach, leftward middle thorn crossing, then a left-end descent and rightward lower crossing, with real reception between turns
play_contract.cheapest_strategy: ordinary outer-right descent is legal fast progress but skips the middle-left cache; the inner exploration route earns the cache without requiring an H/R password
play_contract.choice: two opposite-facing H/R phrases can change approaches, separated by actual stable root landings; ordinary long-held jumps remain legal
play_contract.observe: read the right upper opening, left middle opening and opposite-facing fruits as a three-level route
play_contract.recovery: each normal opening lands on the next broad root; missed outer approaches have a continuous catch basin and return boughs
play_contract.visual: three long solid roots overlap at alternating ends, with naturally hosted upper and underside thorn strips, not a rectangular spike maze

shortcut_contract.scope: optional first inward H/R phrase, with a real middle receiving root before the next phrase; no claim of continuous mandatory air chain
